claims.claim: BBVA Group is an Official Global Banking Partner of UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya with a 400m² Green Zone pavilion hosting 60+ climate finance sessions.
BBVA targets €700 billion in sustainable business (2025–2029), having mobilized €170 billion by Q1 2026 (€36B in Q1 2026 alone).
claims.source: BBVA Sustainability & Garanti BBVA COP31 Release

claims.claim: BBVA explicitly emphasizes bridging the gap between innovation and investment to deploy clean technologies in real-world conditions.
claims.source: BBVA COP31 Sustainability Statement (Javier Rodríguez Soler)

claims.claim: BBVA is listed in the COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group.
claims.source: COP31 Business Forum Working Group Paper
